scope: No original edits, no Unity launch, no runtime instrumentation, no timing reconstruction from mtime. Existing per-case wall includes setup, simulation, observer I/O and final serialization. No native FPS claim.

hypotheses.basis: Construction worker search includes prospective ordinary navigation plus a separate filtered route and repeated current-threat predicates; up to 6 workers and 8 approaches. Source safety has a query-local connectivity optimization, construction does not.

Dutch final has 12 Route blocked; retrying, 219 Idle, 302 owned alive; MovementRecovery can use a 4x grid (512x512) with per-query ally filters. One reserved fine slot bounds scheduling, not individual search time.

hypotheses.topic: Home selection and no-stage army reviews
hypotheses.basis: Home scans each eligible worker/facility against all world entities even when an owned Town exists. Late SelectStage repeatedly fails; all 25 stage candidates require visible/safe 7x7 area before cohort dispatch.

StopRecoveryRepairs runs before thinkAt decision gate each fixed Step; with any active repair it evaluates fresh source safety. A current branch with repairs is needed to test this hypothesis. Final Dutch states show no Repair order, so final-state profile cannot prove earlier repair overhead.

Wall stopwatch includes JSON serialization and writes. Recent trade forecasting scans only the last 60 simulation seconds per eligible post, not all history each Tick. Dutch event/archive size is about 1.3x French, wall about 5.9x; size alone cannot justify attribution.
